findings.meaning-as-a-path: Opening identifies defined-world role interpretation as a proposal. The missing-recipient case makes unanswered roles concrete; bounded experiments are separated from unrestricted language and robotics applications.
findings.sleeper-agents-the-risks-of-deceptive-ai: Opening grounds the concern in persistent experimental backdoors. The trigger example explains what ordinary tests miss; wider attacks stay explicitly speculative and institutional recommendations are not guarantees.
findings.ai-and-the-end-of-scarcity: The food example distinguishes predictive efficiency from distribution. Infrastructure and governance remain conditions; the closing invites comparison instead of promising abundance.
findings.ai-and-the-new-educational-frontier: Different learning paces introduce personalization while shared social learning remains explicit. Profiling, access and educational purpose prevent a score-optimization product pitch.
findings.an-ais-perspective-on-kabbalah-and-taois: The maps are a conceptual analogy, not a statement that traditions or physical theories are identical. Scientific language does not establish mystical cosmology; introductory terms remain the reading route.
findings.blockchain-and-ai-enterprise-customers: The sequence is customer discovery then testable pilot and feedback. Community and consortium financing are proposed arrangements, with no current program entitlement or sales guarantee asserted.
findings.digital-delusions-when-ai-peers-into-hum: The opening names fictional papers and voices, and invented measurements are never presented as real research. The roundtable is a premise and reading invitation; its later resolutions are withheld.
findings.exploring-formal-logic-an-ai-assisted-ed: The wet street illustrates affirming the consequent without assuming true-world causation. Formal proof remains conditional on definitions and premises; differing logical languages are introduced as tools.
findings.introduction-to-artificial-intelligence: Learning, rules, recognition and planning are distinguished rather than conflated. The source perspective on future developments is dated to 2024; the closing offers a reading map.
findings.mastering-human-like-writing-with-ai: The customer reply tests practical usefulness rather than superficial warmth. Creative-world continuity gives a second concrete case, with authorship, accuracy and judgment retained.
findings.planetary-sky-understanding-the-colors-a: Noon and sunset introduce light-path length and scattering; particle types and measurement develop the abstraction. No specific alien-sky color or deterministic weather forecast is invented.
findings.the-mirage-of-stability-in-financial-cri: The speculative market example explains collective expectations without giving investment advice. Intervention is presented with trade-offs and cross-border effects, not a crisis prediction.
findings.top-ten-ways-to-improve-emotional-intell: A difficult message creates a small observable awareness/pause/response example. Listening is distinct from agreement; practice and feedback replace a fixed score or promised clinical benefit.
findings.world-as-a-system: Composed eastward moves and an irrelevant museum fact come from the source. Rules, quorum and resource flows retain their conditions; the answer key is explicitly something to check.

reviewer: Active LLM separate reading and editorial review; not a second agent or human certification.
